title: DOW-UAP-PR112, Unresolved UAP Report, Eastern United States, 2019
what_is_it: A short infrared video clip (20 seconds) of an unidentified anomalous phenomenon, submitted by the US Navy to the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO).
interpretation_warnings: No usable text was extracted from the PDF; most facts derive from war.gov metadata and the accompanying video description rather than a primary document body.
The observer's characterisation is subjective and single-source; the debrief (DOW-UAP-D090) is not included here.
The footage is only 20 seconds and much of it is degraded by sensor zoom/display-mode changes that flash the screen white, limiting what can be verified.
The document title labels this an 'Unresolved' UAP report — no confirmed identification of the object is claimed.
The observer is not named in the source.
